email.body1:
Brent, saw FloQast launched its AI Agent Builder globally and partnered with Forvis Mazars Germany.

A push that fast usually means more accounts in play than the inside team can cover before new reps ramp, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for FloQast off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Brent, quick follow-up for FloQast.

After a global launch, expectations on pipeline usually jump faster than headcount can. Most inside teams do not actually know how many meetings they need to hit the number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings FloQast needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Brent, last bit of proof for FloQast.

Memgraph had more accounts in play than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how FloQast's reply rate likely compares to peer B2B software teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?

Brent, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling inside-sales coverage without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. I know post-launch quarters get loud, and not every initiative makes the cut.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of 3 AI-SDR plays scoped to an inside-sales motion? I will tailor it to FloQast either way.
